text:
Palladium Price in 2017
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2017, the LBMA palladium price rose 39.8% between 2017-01-31 ($756) and 2017-12-28 ($1,057). The highest sampled price was $1,057 in December and the lowest was $756 in January. The mean of these observations was $885. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
